scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker-compose down && docker build --no-cache -t photo-viewer:latest . && docker-compose up -d
scripts.validate:env: node -e "if (!process.env.PHOTOS_DIR) { console.error('ERROR: PHOTOS_DIR not set'); process.exit(1); } console.log('Environment validated')"
scripts.deploy:check: npm run validate:env && npm run build && echo 'Ready for deployment'
